findings.desc: decision_doc_save scope guard can be bypassed conceptually because it accepts current checklist file declarations after the scope contract fails. checklist_update permits files updates in DEV, while decision_doc_save is also DEV-only, so a DEV actor can add docs/requirements/decisions/<slug>.md to checklist files and then save without a PLAN-frozen scope contract or accepted scope extension. This violates the product boundary that save must not become a back door for expanding story scope during DEV.
